item.title: Plumbing License Exam: 15 Questions People Ask, Answered
item.description: How hard is the plumbing license exam, what does a plumbing license cost and how long does it take to become a licensed plumber? Straight answers to the 15 questions plumbers search most. Each answer is short, plain and checked against the official board and exam sources.
